x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: voluntary unemployment means unwillingness to work at the prevailing wage, involuntary means willing at the going wage but finding no job. Statement 3 is false: the labour force counts only involuntary unemployment, not voluntary.

Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct: Velugu (2000) was the World Bank-aided District Poverty Initiatives Project run by SERP through village organisations and mandal samakhyas. Statement 4 is false: Indira Kranthi Patham came later (2004-05), formed by merging Velugu and DWCRA.
